fields.h1: Build a Bake Sale Sign-Up Sheet That Balances the Table
fields.hero_description: Build a bake sale sign up sheet that counts the dozens pledged per category and emails each baker a drop-off window.
fields.explore_cta: Build My Bake Sale Sign-Up Sheet
fields.features_heading: What the Sheet Sorts Out Before Sale Morning
fields.features_subheading: A paper sheet holds names and items. Build one with Emergent, and the app also counts dozens and books each baker's drop-off time.
fields.feature_1:
A goal in dozens for each category

Set a target per category, such as 12 dozen cupcakes or 6 loaves of banana bread. Each pledge counts toward it, and a category that reaches its target closes to new bakers.
fields.feature_2:
Drop-off windows bakers choose

Offer 30-minute windows on sale morning and let each baker take one. You know which trays arrive at 7:30 and which at 8:00, and no window takes more bakers than you allow.
fields.feature_3:
An allergen question on every pledge

Ask what each item contains, with a box for peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, wheat, and the rest. The answers fill a label for the tray, which a volunteer prints and tapes beside it.
fields.feature_4:
Prices set before the table opens

Set a price per piece for each category, $1 a cookie or $2.50 a cupcake. The sheet multiplies it by the pieces pledged and shows what the table takes in if every tray sells out.
fields.feature_5:
One view of who is bringing what

See every pledge on one dashboard: baker, item, category, dozens, and drop-off window. Change the sheet by describing the change, and Emergent rebuilds the form and the dashboard.
fields.feature_6:
Pledges stored where you can reach them

Keep every baker and pledge in a database you own, ready for the next sale's invites. On paid plans, export the full code of the sheet to your GitHub repository and host it anywhere.

fields.usecase_heading: How Four Bake Sales Filled Their Tables
fields.tab_content_1:
Cupcakes close at 12 dozen, and every gap shows

Kellerby Elementary needs 12 dozen cupcakes and 8 dozen cookies for its fall bake sale, plus 6 dozen brownies. Bakers pledge all 12 dozen cupcakes by Tuesday, and the cupcake option closes. Lowenna Druce signs up next and sees cookies at 5 of 8 dozen and brownies at 2 of 6. She pledges 2 dozen brownies.
fields.tab_content_2:
The evening before, each baker gets a reminder

Sale morning at Druidsmere Lutheran Church starts at 9:00, and the kitchen fits only a few trays at once. Bakers pick a 30-minute drop-off window, with room for four bakers in each. The evening before, Basilio Trevelyan gets an email with his 8:00 window for a lemon pound cake and a note to use the side door.
fields.tab_content_3:
Peanuts or sesame in a tray go on its label

Peanut butter bars and sesame brittle sit two tables from shortbread at Bexbridge Youth Soccer's sale. Each baker ticks which of the nine major food allergens their item contains, and the app turns the answers into a label for each of the 22 trays. The brittle's label reads contains sesame. Parents read it before they buy.
fields.tab_content_4:
No one has shift 6, and Eudora knows 3 days out

Eight hours of table time fill the Friends of the Glenhallow Library sale, one volunteer per 1-hour shift. Seven of the 8 shifts are taken by Wednesday. Shift 6, at 2:00 PM, still has no name. Coordinator Eudora Tillotson gets an email 3 days before the sale that names the open hour.

faq_plan.q: What is a bake sale sign up sheet?
How do I create a bake sale sign up sheet?

plan.angle: The top 10 for bake sale sign up sheet is printable grids from Etsy, Pinterest and template sites plus two online sign-up tools: a column for a name and a column for an item. This page shows the sheet as the system that runs the sale: dozen goals per category that close when met, drop-off windows with a reminder the evening before, allergen labels made from each baker's answers, and selling shifts that alert one coordinator when a slot sits empty. The how-to and FAQ add what printables skip: how many dozen to ask for, pricing by the piece, and what to ask about ingredients.
tab_stories: Kellerby Elementary PTA sets a goal of 12 dozen cupcakes, and once bakers pledge 12 dozen the cupcake option closes, so the next baker picks from the categories still short.
Druidsmere Lutheran Church gives each baker a 30-minute drop-off window on sale morning, and every baker gets an email the evening before with their window and the side door to use.
Bexbridge Youth Soccer asks each baker which of the nine major food allergens their item contains, and the app turns each entry into a table label listing them.
The Friends of the Glenhallow Library fill eight 1-hour selling shifts, and a shift still empty 3 days before the sale sends an email to coordinator Eudora Tillotson.
